subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Manipulates household containers and sorts them into those that slide and those that roll

show.line: Some things roll. Some things slide. A ball rolls. A box slides. Let's find out!

rounds.prompt: Which one rolls down the hill?
rounds.praise: Yes! A ball is round, so it rolls.

rounds.prompt: Which one slides? It has flat sides.
rounds.praise: Yes! A book is flat. It slides.

rounds.prompt: Look at the tin on its side. Does it roll or slide?
Roll or slide? Put each thing in its group.
Why does the ball roll? Tap the round one.

rounds.story: Thandi drops a tin. It rolls under the stove. Mama says, careful, the stove is hot! What rolled away?

hints: Round things roll. Flat things slide.
Feel the sides. Round or flat?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a thing that rolls.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This box! It rolls down the hill.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A box has flat sides. It slides.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A box is flat. Flat things slide!

parent_line: Can sort things into those that roll and those that slide.
